summary: Examples of mount_facts: non-local devices, FUSE mounts, NFS mounts during gather_facts with a timeout, a non-default fstab location, and using the mount binary.
questions: How do I gather only network mounts?
How do I include mount_facts in gather_facts with a timeout?
How do I read mounts from a custom fstab path?

answer_card.title: mount_facts examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- mount_facts: {devices: "[!/]*"}          # non-local
- mount_facts: {fstypes: ["fuse.*"]}
- hosts: all
  gather_facts: true
  vars:
    ansible_facts_modules: [ansible.builtin.mount_facts]
  module_defaults:
    ansible.builtin.mount_facts:
      timeout: 10
      fstypes: [nfs, nfs4]
- mount_facts: {sources: [/usr/etc/fstab]}
- mount_facts: {sources: [mount], mount_binary: /sbin/mount}
```
